fact: On 30 April 2026 a workshop at ENSEA validated the synthesis report of the SNDS 2026-2030, presented with its diagnosis, vision, financing plan, monitoring-evaluation framework and alignment with the PND 2026-2030.
title: Côte d'Ivoire-AIP/ Un atelier pour valider la Stratégie nationale de développement de la statistique 2026-2030
